body: Create an overhead aerial photograph of a small {{building}} on a rugged coastal headland. Transform the ground around it into sweeping hand-painted ribbons of coral, turquoise and saffron, with concentric arcs following the natural contour of the cliff. Keep the building and ocean physically realistic. Tiny seabirds provide scale, fractured sea ice fades into deep water, flat overcast light, precise graphic composition, no lettering.

instructions.en: No reference image is needed. Copy the full prompt into your image generator.
instructions.zh-Hans: 无需参考图，将完整提示词复制到图像生成工具即可。

en.title: Painted cliff lighthouse
en.description: Painted coral, turquoise and saffron bands follow a rocky coast around a white lighthouse.
en.body:
## How to use

Choose a compact coastal building. Keep the aerial view and make the paint follow the terrain instead of floating above it.

## Recorded result

The default was generated with the built-in image tool. The precise provider model ID was not returned. Other values are not yet tested.
